title: Home guide: the blubber test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Living things and their habitats (Frozen Kingdom)
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 16 (Home practical guide and safety card: blubber test (portal worksheet; warm tap water, adult pours))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how a layer of fat keeps polar animals warm.
equipment: Three equal jars and a measuring jug
Fleece, butter or lard in a sandwich bag, elastic bands
A kitchen thermometer if you have one
safety: Warm tap water only; an adult pours it
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Wrap one jar in fleece and one in the bag of butter (the 'blubber'). Leave one bare.
An adult pours the same amount of warm water into each jar.
